mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmWmsCheckPopList*/ SELECT 'KEPMRO' AS BUYER, 'KEPMRO' AS BUYER_NAME, IT.STDCATLG_ID AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS AGENT_NAME, IT.CMS_CATLG_ID, ST.TOT_QTY, MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AS MAP_CMS_CATLG_ID, (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM MST_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND RECORD_STATUS <> 'D') AS USE_YN FROM ITEMMAST IT, XPROCQDT CQ, CMSMAPPING MP, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.STDCATLG_ID = CQ.STDCATLG_ID AND CQ.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND IT.STDCATLG_ID = MP.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.CMS_CATLG_ID <> MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE = DECODE (CQ.LOCATION_NO, '01', 'KRKORE0068', '02', 'KRKORE0126') AND ST.STDCATLG_ID = IT.CMS_CATLG_ID AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D' UNION ALL SELECT 'KEPMRO', 'KEPMRO', IT.STDCATLG_ID, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE), IT.CMS_CATLG_ID, ST.TOT_QTY, MP.CMS_CATLG_ID, (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM MST_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND RECORD_STATUS <> 'D') FROM ITEMMAST IT, XPROCQSP CQ, CMSMAPPING MP, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.STDCATLG_ID = CQ.STDCATLG_ID AND IT.STDCATLG_ID = MP.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQ.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND CQ.BUYER IN ('KRXPR00465') AND IT.CMS_CATLG_ID <> MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND IT.CMS_CATLG_ID = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY BUYER_ITEM_NO

/*selectMasterMdCmWmsCheckPopListKA*/ SELECT IT.BUYER, DECODE ( (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IT.BUYER), NULL, (SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE = IT.BUYER), (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IT.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQ.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, IT.CMS_CATLG_ID, ST.TOT_QTY, MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AS MAP_CMS_CATLG_ID, 0 AS USE_YN FROM ICOMBYIT IT, ICOMCQDT CQ, CMSMAPPING MP, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.BUYER = CQ.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQ.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND IT.BUYER = MP.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = MP.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.BUYER NOT IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'HUB') AND IT.CMS_CATLG_ID <> MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE = (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'HUB' AND CODE = CQ.AGENT) AND ST.STDCATLG_ID = IT.CMS_CATLG_ID AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D' UNION ALL SELECT IT.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IT.BUYER), IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = IT.BUYER), IT.CMS_CATLG_ID, ST.TOT_QTY, MP.CMS_CATLG_ID, 0 AS USE_YN FROM ICOMBYIT IT, ICOMCQDT CQ, CMSMAPPING MP, WMSSTCK ST WHERE IT.BUYER = CQ.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.BUYER = MP.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = MP.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'HUB') AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO <> MP.CMS_CATLG_ID AND IT.BUYER = ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND IT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D'
